1. minor (line 49): The hook subscribes in useEffect after render. If the proxy's initialize() runs between this render and the effect commit (possible under concurrent rendering), the notification is missed and the memoized route function stays at the bootstrap value until some other dependency changes. The same applies to packages/core-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx:109. Confidence: medium. In practice the window is narrow, because bootstrap components commit long before sign-in completes. — fix: After subscribing in the effect, check whether resolution changed since render. For example, capture `routeResolutionApi.isPending?.()` at render and compare it inside the effect, or call `setRevision(r => r + 1)` once when that value differs. Then return the unsubscribe function.
